name: com.uee03.pretzel.integrations
description: Optional adapters between Pretzel and LitMotion, UniTask, R3 and VContainer. Each adapter assembly compiles only when its library is installed.

samples.description: One demo per library (LitMotion, UniTask, R3), one for R3 with Pretzel Events, and one that combines LitMotion, UniTask and R3.

Every VContainer feature in one scene with one LifetimeScope, one folder per feature: registration, lifetimes, injection, entry points, tickable timers and bullets, factories, components, collections, keys, open generics, settings, installers, callbacks and child scopes.
